verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean never forms log(z₊/P); it states the same two facts multiplicatively, and the rewriting is routine because z₊ > 0 (proved, not assumed: positive_invariant_cone) and P > 0 (hPpos). First half: with P' = (λ - d_ref)P (hP) and z₊' = (λ - d + E₁₁)z₊ + E₁₂z₋ (modalOperator), dividing relative_error_of_cone's left-hand side by p = z₊ gives exactly (log(z₊/P))' = -(d - d_ref) + E₁₁ + E₁₂(z₋/z₊), and its right-hand side δ + eps(1+r) = D/S_* + (C/S_*)(1 + K_b/S_*) ≤ (D + 2C)/S_* is the paper's O(S_*^{-1}) (the hmu step, scaled_growing_mode_bounds line 388). Second half: the two-sided envelope exp(∓(D+2C)L) · (z₊(a)/P(a)) · P(t) is the exponential of |log(z₊/P)| ≤ (D+2C)L, under the paper's normalisation z₊(a) = P(a) (used in primary_bounds line 470, hratio). The paper's chain Cv/S_* ≤ C L_s/S_* ≤ C becomes ((D+2C)/S)(t-a) ≤ (D+2C)L from hslot : b - a ≤ L*S, i.e. slot length L_s ≤ L·S_*. The constant is explicit (D + 2C, D from the damping error and 2C from the two coefficient errors) where the paper writes a generic C; no bound is weaker.
